svg.title: Infective endocarditis decision chart: blood cultures and echocardiography are counted against the modified Duke criteria, then the valve and the culture result (native valve, prosthetic valve or device, culture-negative) decide the likely organism, the echo route and the antibiotics; panels give the indications and timing for surgery and who gets dental prophylaxis

svg.text: Fever + a damaged valve, a device, IV drug use or a new murmur: is it infective endocarditis (IE)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: search every system for EMBOLI and for HEART FAILURE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · Three sets of blood cultures → 2 · Transthoracic echo (TTE) → 3 · Count the modified DUKE criteria

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cultures from 3 sites, all within the first hour if very sick; echo as soon as IE is suspected

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DEFINITE: 2 major, 1 major + 3 minor, or 5 minor | POSSIBLE: 1 major + 1 minor, or 3 minor → treat both

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • MAJOR: typical organism in 2 cultures, cultures persistently positive (> 12 h apart), Coxiella, or echo showing vegetation, abscess or new

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • MINOR: predisposing heart lesion or IV drug use, fever ≥ 38 °C, emboli (Janeway lesions), immune signs (Osler nodes, Roth spots)
